brands.name: T-Mobile

sources.says: T-Mobile never asks you to confirm sensitive information in an unsolicited text; forward suspicious texts to 7726 (that number is for reporting, not a sender). The page doesn't list the numbers T-Mobile texts from.
Usage and roaming alerts arrive as free T-Mobile text messages; the #646#, #674#, #932# and #225# codes are dialed by the customer, not senders. No sending short codes are listed.
